text:
Maria’s motive to explore history and its lessons is structurally embedded in the narrative through the lens of archaeology, which serves as a literal and metaphorical bridge between eras. By focusing on a group uncovering ancient remains, she creates a thematic framework that emphasizes time, continuity, and change. This structure allows her to illustrate how the past actively shapes the present and future, turning the act of discovery into a commentary on the enduring influence of history.
